Hi Jorge,

That makes sense, and please don't force anything together. Sending them back the way they came to you is exactly right, and I'd rather you didn't repack sealed units.

So you can use three boxes, one per unit, I've asked the team for two extra prepaid labels, one for the Jingle Miner and one for the DC06 kit. A colleague is picking that up today, and they'll come to you at this address. The label you already have stays with the NerdQX box.

Please write Shop···· clearly on the outside of each box, so all three land on the same return when they reach us.

Nothing else changes: the $596.12 in store credit goes onto your account once the units arrive at our warehouse. Hold on to the Jingle and the QX as they are until the extra labels reach you.

Thanks for your patience with this one.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
